observations: Steal An Egg leads Most Popular, followed by Brookhaven and Throw Food For Animals (67 days old); Clean The Ballpit rose 15 places and 5 games entered while 7 fell off.
Median pillar percentile by age: 85-122 days sits highest (74, n=4), then multi-year games (64), while 15-42 day games sit at 41, so recent breakouts still trail established games.

Update recency is the strongest controllable signal (days since update vs days on chart rho -0.35), and a high favorite rate per visit goes with lower positions (rho -0.37), consistent with big evergreens converting fewer visits into favorites.
patterns: Steal-and-defend (median percentile 74), wave-survival co-op (70) and party minigames (69) rank above physics sandboxes (39) and sports leagues (35); sandboxes tend to rank lower here and Ragdoll titles carry r=-0.14.

Video observations of long-running hits tend to show light HUDs and social or roleplay structure (Brookhaven HUD 1, Warrior Cats), with fast-paced duel shooters showing skin-based monetization; these are few games and confidence stays low.
Visit count and group size correlate with longevity but are outcome-linked, so they are partly a result of success rather than a lever.

outliers.name: Throw Food For Animals
outliers.note: Reaches #3 at 67 days with only 2 passes, breaking the usual age-trough pattern; it is the template the throw-for-luck clones now follow.

outliers.name: Clean The Ballpit!
outliers.note: Only 24 days old yet rising 15 places on Most Popular, likely helped by a new themed map every 2-3 days.

observations: Era Of Witches (30 days, 169K visits) ranks among the most efficient games, as does a donation-style Social game, while Guts & Blackpowder jumped 188 places and Fish for Secret Animals 117.
Median developer-product price above about 79 R$ is the strongest page signal (rho +0.39); games older than about 28 days also earn more per player (rho +0.34).
Fallers include Clover RPG (-104) and Ride An Egg (-78), showing that efficiency positions swing widely day to day.
patterns: RPG genre (r +0.59) and story-adventure loops (+0.60) consistently earn the most for their CCU, while physics sandboxes (-0.51) and Ragdoll titles (-0.68) earn the least.
Reward-flex thumbnails go with lower efficiency (r -0.26), consistent with those thumbnails belonging to the newer incremental and pet games.

Newer games in the queue sell cheap luck or cash products, while efficient earners such as Grand Blue sell fruit chests up to 9,800 R$ and Mechs vs Kaiju sells Robux packs up to 1,199 R$, which fits the price-ladder hypothesis.

outliers.name: Mechs vs Kaiju's Ragdoll
outliers.note: A young physics game at Top Earning #112 despite the sandbox penalty, probably because its mech roll packs carry high prices.

outliers.name: Era Of Witches
outliers.note: A 30-day-old game with 1.2K favorites ranking near the top on efficiency, plausibly because of 1,000 R$ character passes and low CCU.

observations: Tumble Dash rose 31 places and My Lucky Scoop Studio 21; Mukbang Students fell 9; 10 games entered, including Chase a Storm, two plane-crash sandboxes, Deep Clean ASMR and +1 Hedgehog Evolve.
Among 73 games aged 0-4 months, updates per week go with higher positions (rho +0.38) within the same age band.
Party minigames show the strongest momentum signal (r +0.67 on only 8 games, within-age +0.63), so it may be a small-sample effect.
patterns: Physics-sandbox mechanics go with weaker momentum (r -0.45, within-age -0.46) and Ragdoll titles with lower positions (r -0.47), consistent with a saturating wave.
Page videos (r +0.35) and shorter, update-heavy release rhythms tend to go with higher positions, while bracket update tags (r -0.50) and clan mechanics (-0.54) go with lower ones.
New entrants today rely on a single clear hazard or ASMR hook, and Deep Clean ASMR enters despite a 62% like ratio.

outliers.name: Tumble Dash
outliers.note: Biggest riser at 68% likes and 1 pass, which suggests the party format and novelty can outweigh polish in a young game.

outliers.name: JAWS BELOW

observations: RUN FROM THE DOGS (+67), Troll Tongue Tower (+51), Chase a Storm (+49), Throw a Friend for Monsters (+40) and +1 Jutsu Evolution (+39) are the biggest risers; Slime Studio, Animal Ragdoll, Can You Land A Plane?, Renovate the Floor and +1 Anime Speed fell 23-40 places.
10 games entered and 12 left; 87 of 96 games are 15-42 days old, so age mix matters little for ranking inside the chart.
Update frequency remains the clearest predictor (updates per week rho +0.39, within-age +0.38), while spin or crate products go with lower positions (r -0.41, 81 of 96 games have them).
patterns: Creature and monster themes tend to rank higher within age (r +0.31), and survival-framed games and core-competitive loops also lean higher.
Throw-or-cast-for-luck games (Monsters, Clowns, Fish) combine 92-96% likes with 100-190K favorites, though plain +1 and egg games rank lower.
Two cheap kid-oriented hits (RUN FROM THE DOGS, Troll Tongue Tower) rose steeply with 68-76% likes, so like ratio alone does not explain rank.

outliers.name: Chase a Storm!
outliers.note: Rose 49 places to #4 with 97% likes and a 17-pass price ladder, unusual for a young game, probably because of its distinct co-op storm-filming idea.

outliers.name: Slime Studio [SANDBOX]
outliers.note: Fell 23 places with a standard physics ASMR template, suggesting sandbox saturation.

summary: The throw-for-luck template (Throw a Friend for Monsters, Throw Food For Clowns, Cast For Fish, Fish A Pirate) now has four members across Up-and-Coming and Top Earning; this may reflect one wave from several copycat groups.
No new outside research today; analysis/research/2026-10-29-survival-and-monetization.md was already ingested.
Physics sandboxes rank lower on Top Earning and show weaker Top Trending momentum, yet plane-crash variants keep entering, so novelty of the physics hook may matter more than the genre.
